entries.title: Philemon 1:1
segments: ¶Paul, prisoner of Christ Jesus, and Timotheus the brother, to Philemon the beloved and our fellow-workman,

entries.title: Philemon 1:2
segments: and to the sister Apphia and to Archippus our fellow-soldier, and to the assembly which [is] in thine house.

entries.title: Philemon 1:3
segments: Grace to you and peace from God our Father, and [the] Lord Jesus Christ.

entries.title: Philemon 1:4
segments: I thank my God, always making mention of thee at my prayers,

entries.title: Philemon 1:5
segments: hearing of thy love and the faith which thou hast towards the Lord Jesus, and towards all the saints,

entries.title: Philemon 1:6
segments: in such sort that thy participation in the faith should become operative in the acknowledgment of every good thing which is in us towards Christ [Jesus].

entries.title: Philemon 1:7
segments: For we have great thankfulness and encouragement through thy love, because the bowels of the saints are refreshed by thee, brother.

entries.title: Philemon 1:8
segments: ¶Wherefore having much boldness in Christ to enjoin thee what is fitting,

entries.title: Philemon 1:9
segments: for love's sake I rather exhort, being such a one as Paul the aged, and now also prisoner of Jesus Christ.

entries.title: Philemon 1:10
segments: I exhort thee for *my* child, whom I have begotten in [my] bonds, Onesimus,

entries.title: Philemon 1:11
segments: once unserviceable to thee, but now serviceable to thee and to me:

entries.title: Philemon 1:12
segments: whom I have sent back to thee: [but do *thou* receive] him, that is, *my* bowels:

entries.title: Philemon 1:13
segments: whom *I* was desirous of keeping with myself, that for thee he might minister to me in the bonds of the glad tidings;

entries.title: Philemon 1:14
segments: but I have wished to do nothing without thy mind, that thy good might not be as of necessity but of willingness:

entries.title: Philemon 1:15
segments: for perhaps for this reason he has been separated [from thee] for a time, that thou mightest possess him fully for ever;

entries.title: Philemon 1:16
segments: not any longer as a bondman, but above a bondman, a beloved brother, specially to me, and how much rather to thee, both in [the] flesh and in [the] Lord?

entries.title: Philemon 1:17
segments: If therefore thou holdest me to be a partner [with thee], receive him as me;

entries.title: Philemon 1:18
segments: but if he have wronged thee anything or owe anything [to thee], put this to my account.

entries.title: Philemon 1:19
segments: *I* Paul have written [it] with mine own hand; *I* will repay [it]: that I say not to thee that thou owest even thine own self also to me.

entries.title: Philemon 1:20
segments: Yea, brother, *I* would have profit of *thee* in [the] Lord: refresh my bowels in Christ.

entries.title: Philemon 1:21
segments: Being confident of thine obedience, I have written to thee, knowing that thou wilt do even more than I say.

entries.title: Philemon 1:22
segments: But withal prepare me also a lodging; for I hope that I shall be granted to you through your prayers.

entries.title: Philemon 1:23
segments: Epaphras salutes thee, my fellow-prisoner in Christ Jesus;

entries.title: Philemon 1:24
segments: Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, Luke, my fellow-workmen.

entries.title: Philemon 1:25
segments: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ [be] with your spirit.
